environment.hardware: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Engineering Reference Developer Kit Super
environment.notes: Sequential fixtures in isolated 900×1600 Chromium; software rendering; eight-second startup/font warmup. No microphone capture or production device actions. The separately labelled live-model suite republishes one opt-in provider observation.

suites.title: Instant native UI updates
suites.description: How quickly an already-open Garden surface accepts a new reading.
suites.method: 30 sequential keyed metric patches after warmup; focus remains on an unchanged button.
suites.limits: DOM and two animation-frame callbacks. This does not measure physical screen presentation or model latency.

suites.title: A briefing takes shape
suites.description: The shell appears first; weather, rides and news fill independently.
suites.method: 10 full briefings with deterministic sources: forecast 80 ms, transit 160 ms, news 240 ms. Warm weather cache after wall startup.
suites.limits: Controlled provider fixtures isolate rendering/orchestration. Real internet, model and microphone delays vary.

suites.title: Weather without waiting again
suites.description: Memory, persistent browser cache and concurrent requests reuse the same forecast.
suites.method: One controlled 80 ms cold request, 30 memory hits, 20 fresh-module persisted-cache reads, and 12 simultaneous calls for one new location.
suites.limits: Cache timings exclude module import/download. The single cold sample is a demonstration, not a distribution.

suites.title: A2UI: real streaming components
suites.description: Official A2UI/Lit runtime, typed input and keyed data bindings.
suites.method: One first-runtime request, 10 warmed surface creations, 30 sequential bound-data patches. An unchanged typed input retains focus and value; a real generated button opens Weather in the isolated page.
suites.limits: First-runtime sample includes local bundle download/parse, not an internet CDN. One cold sample is not a cold-start distribution. Frame callbacks do not measure physical screen latency.

suites.title: Controls without a model round trip
suites.description: Typed generated actions resolve to the same Garden operations as voice and clicks.
suites.method: 30 sequential batches of 1,000 action resolutions, cycling 13 real action types. No action sinks executed. Times are batch-amortized microseconds/call.
suites.limits: Resolver-only CPU time. No speaker, timer, power or device action was actually executed.

suites.title: Talk to Paseo locally
suites.description: Read the existing coding agent’s status and activity without launching its CLI.
suites.method: 20 sequential real local MCP read-only status/activity calls; no agents spawned or prompted; no returned household content stored.
suites.limits: This measures local daemon HTTP/tool latency, not model inference, task completion, event delivery or polling delay.

suites.title: JSON that arrives in pieces
suites.description: Only complete, correctly framed A2UI messages are delivered.
suites.method: Node regression tests across every chunk width, UTF-8 and surrogate splits, misleading quoted/nested keys, invalid grammar and bounded byte/count/depth limits.
suites.limits: Parser correctness only. No model, rendering or physical display latency is measured.
notes: Pass/fail regression checks. No timing claim.

suites.title: Voice generation without obsolete updates
suites.description: Streamed UI stays ordered, waits for routing, and respects cancellation.
suites.method: Actual voice stream orchestration and SDK SSE handling exercised with synthetic tool JSON and mocked provider fetch. Tests incremental paint before completion, serial dispatch, router gate, cancellation, failure, deduplication and malformed-tail retirement.
suites.limits: No household audio, live model request or device action. These pass/fail cases do not measure recognition accuracy or voice-response latency.
notes: Pass/fail regression checks. No timing claim.

suites.title: The model starts drawing before it finishes
suites.description: A real Haiku tool response reaches the production stream bridge and official A2UI browser renderer.
suites.method: One live provider tool response into the production stream bridge and actual A2UI browser renderer; synthetic prompt, isolated profile, no microphone.
suites.limits: Single observation, not a latency distribution or comparison of models. Excludes speech capture, ASR, wake word and physical display. Forced tool choice; not an intent-routing evaluation. No p95 or latency distribution is estimated. This opt-in cloud test incurs provider usage; the ordinary benchmark runner only republishes its existing artifact.

metrics.label: First rendered content
metrics.warmth: one live provider observation; forced A2UI tool

notes: One live observation using claude-haiku-5-5. Forced tool choice and a synthetic prompt; the result does not compare models or measure normal intent routing.

Fine-grained tool streaming is enabled on the A2UI tool using eager_input_streaming:true. Official documentation: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/fine-grained-tool-streaming
First rendered content is the first GardenMetric observed in the actual isolated browser. It does not include wake word, speech capture, ASR or physical screen presentation.

An earlier buffered observation rendered content at 4339.23 ms, after provider completion at 3910.15 ms. Its renderedBeforeProviderComplete flag was false. The saved passed flag reflects the older completion criterion; it does not establish progressive visibility. Raw observation retained in live-model-buffered.json.

The current call and the buffered call are single independent observations. Their timing difference is not a statistical speedup estimate; the demonstrated behavior is rendering before provider completion.
